research.title_en: Longitudinal imaging cohort with explicit power analysis

summaries.scientific_en_≤300w: Large mouse imaging cohort for longitudinal signal quantification with explicit power assumptions.

alternatives_search.conclusion: No non-animal method reproduces longitudinal whole-body kinetics.

n_justification.details: Power analysis assumed alpha 0.05, power 0.8, effect size 0.6, and 36 animals per arm with 10% attrition reserve.

experiments.label: Longitudinal imaging
experiments.question: Track longitudinal imaging signal across three treatment arms.

procedure_timeline.step: Animals undergo non-survival imaging and are euthanized at scheduled harvest.

general: Scheduled harvest or earlier euthanasia for distress.
specific: Persistent lethargy or 15% weight loss triggers euthanasia.
